meta.project: Ming's OS — Staff Cockpit Product Spec

product_overview: Ming's OS provides a staff cockpit for restaurant operations with authenticated access to payroll management and internal navigation between operational views. The tested scope focuses on month-based payroll, employee setup, attendance marking, and payment tracking within the staff preview.
core_goals: Sign in to the staff cockpit using email and password
Review and manage monthly employee payroll records
Set employee salary details, including start date and weekly off
Mark attendance day by day for each employee across a month
Record salary payments and view remaining payable amounts
Navigate between cockpit sections using the internal screen switcher

features.name: Staff login
features.description: Authenticate into the staff cockpit with email and password to access internal staff views.
user_flows: Navigate to /spec-ops -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit sign in form -> See staff cockpit
Navigate to /spec-ops -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit sign in form with invalid credentials -> See access denied

features.name: Cockpit navigation
features.description: Move between internal staff cockpit screens using the screen query-based navigation.
user_flows: Navigate to /spec-ops?screen=home -> Select a different cockpit section -> See the requested screen load
Navigate to /spec-ops?screen=home -> Switch between cockpit sections -> Confirm the URL screen query updates

features.name: Month payroll and attendance
features.description: Manage employee payroll by month, maintain employee details, mark attendance day by day, and record payments against monthly payable amounts.
user_flows: Navigate to /spec-ops?screen=staff -> Review the current month payroll view -> Move to the previous month or next month -> See the payroll list update for that month

Navigate to /spec-ops?screen=staff -> Add or edit an employee -> Enter name, designation, monthly salary, start date, and default weekly off -> Save the employee -> See the employee appear in the month list
Navigate to /spec-ops?screen=staff -> Expand an employee row -> Tap a calendar day to cycle the attendance status -> See the day change from Work to Absent to Off
Navigate to /spec-ops?screen=staff -> Review attendance marks for the month -> See payable decrease when days are marked Absent -> See weekly off remain included in salary
Navigate to /spec-ops?screen=staff -> Open the payment form for an employee -> Review the suggested remaining payable amount -> Record a payment -> See paid, remaining, and status update
